what_this_is: The Workshop rows for the tools in tools/words-as-picture-vector: what each tool does, what it takes and gives back, and how it runs.

payload.label: Turn words into a picture vector
payload.job: Turn words into the vector a picture model (CLIP ViT-B-32, OpenAI weights) gives pictures that show them, to compare with picture vectors kept for recordings
payload.description: Encodes 1 to 64 short texts with the CLIP ViT-B-32 text model (OpenAI weights, ONNX export pinned by BLAKE3) and returns one unit-length 512-number vector per text, with the model named, so it is compared only with picture vectors made by the same model. Runs sealed, without the network.
